control_objective: On a quarterly basis, application owners review and formally recertify all user access to financially-significant systems so that access remains commensurate with current job responsibilities.
risk_addressed: Accumulated or stale access that is never re-reviewed allows users to retain entitlements beyond their role, enabling unauthorized transactions that misstate the financial statements.

required_data_elements.business_definition: The full population of in-scope user-entitlement assignments selected for recertification in the cycle.
The application owner's recorded certify/revoke decision for each assignment in the campaign.
The signed attestation evidencing completion of the recertification campaign.

method.summary: Confirm that every in-scope access review in the quarterly recertification campaign was completed, signed off, and has no overdue items.
steps: Pull the access-review campaign population for in-scope systems from Identity Governance.
Determine the percentage of reviews completed (a certify or revoke decision recorded) against the population.
Count reviews still open past their due date as overdue certifications.
Confirm a signed reviewer attestation exists in the SharePoint sign-off library for each campaign.
Confirm revocations resulting from the campaign were actioned and logged.
method.fallback_logic: If either source is unavailable, mark Not Run and raise a Missing Source item rather than passing.

thresholds.materiality_basis: Any incomplete or overdue recertification of access to a financially-significant system is a control exception.
thresholds.warning_threshold: Completion below 100% with no item yet past due

pass_criteria: 100% of in-scope access reviews are completed.
Reviewer sign-off captured for the population.
fail_criteria: One or more in-scope reviews remain incomplete.
One or more recertifications are overdue.
exception_handling: Escalate overdue reviews to the Application Owner and re-test before relying on the control.

downstream_linkage.staleness_rule: Must be re-evidenced each quarter before §302 certification.

actions_on_fail: Notify IT Security Manager and Application Owner
